preflight.definition: Necessary local checks only; passing does not prove global feasibility. Missing optional limits are warnings. Named teaching breaks do not count as teaching capacity.

realism.definition: Idle periods are unoccupied teaching periods between the first and last session; fixed breaks are excluded. Consecutive periods are adjacent teaching periods.

coverage.basis: assignment pairs; exact room/instructor/group IDs, half-open time intervals
selected objective profile and independently observed components

validation.conflict_basis: Exact group IDs represent disjoint cohorts. Any shared instructor, room or group is a conflict when half-open intervals overlap; adjacency and fixed breaks are allowed.

provenance.reproducibility_note: Parallel search can produce different feasible schedules with identical inputs and seed.
